title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Add a Scan Barcode action and scan multiple/Continious scanning (Invoke barcode scanning programmatically from AL)
summary: Business Central version 24 introduced barcode scanning APIs using control add-ins to replace .NET-based APIs, enabling developers to add scan actions and continuous scanning to custom pages via the CameraBarcodeScannerProviderAddIn control add-in.
key_points: Setting ExtendedDatatype to Barcode on a table or page field shows a scan button in the mobile app.
From version 24, the CameraBarcodeScannerProviderAddIn control add-in replaces the .NET barcode APIs, which were on-premises only, for custom scan actions.
Call RequestBarcodeAsync from an action and handle the ControlAddInReady, BarcodeAvailable and BarcodeFailure triggers.
Calling RequestBarcodeAsync again inside BarcodeAvailable turns on continuous scanning.
Example: a Sales Order action scans Lot No. barcodes and adds the matching item as sales lines.

quotes.text: Version 24 introduced barcode scanning APIs based on control add-ins to replace the .NET-based APIs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the shift to the recommended approach for implementing barcode scanning in custom extensions

quotes.text: This means we can add scan barcode actions and multiple scanning functions to our own extensions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Enables developers to create custom barcode scanning capabilities beyond standard Business Central functionality

quotes.text: Enabling multiple scans is also very simple; just remove the comments from step 5 in the sample.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that continuous scanning requires minimal code changes, making it practical for real-world scenarios
